thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1 model-quality-regression detected

incident-bot: Summary: automated evals and customer-side error hooks show a sudden increase in hallucinations and failed safety clamps for model 'redwood-delta-13b' (v2026-03-15-1). Impact: elevated complaint volume for completions, ~4x bad-response rate on production traffic for the last 8 minutes. Link: <https://internal/ops/incidents/1774329102>

Kai: I'm oncall. Looking now. Any deploys in the last hour?

Priya: I see a canary promotion at 2026-03-15T09:12 UTC for that model variant (CI job #4221). Telemetry shows spike exactly after that.

Elena: Confirming — automated evals failing on safety tests and rouge token increase. Latency normal, but quality drift consistent across regions.

Jamal: Support reports 6 customers with direct complaints so far, two high-touch. Triage is collecting example completions.

Kai: Ok plan: 1) Quick rollback of the model promotion to previous pinned artifact. 2) Pin rollout to previous stable model. 3) Post an incident status page update and customer-facing template. 4) Triage root cause after mitigation. Taking ownership of steps 1 & 2.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: rollback initiated by Kai — reverting model rollout to 'redwood-delta-13b@2026-03-12-4'. Execution id: rollback-1774329165.

Kai: Running rollback command now:```bash
redwoodctl rollout revert --model redwood-delta-13b --to-tag 2026-03-12-4 --namespace prod
```

Priya: While rollback runs, SRE: please pin API traffic to stable variant to avoid automatic re-promotions. Patch suggestion: set model param to exact artifact in routing rules. Example snippet for routes config:```yaml
routes:
  - name: text-gen-prod
    match: "/v1/generate"
    model: "redwood-delta-13b@2026-03-12-4"
    fallback: "redwood-delta-13b-quant@2026-03-12-4"
```

Kai: Rollback completed (deploy-bot reports success). Verifying traffic now.

Elena: Sampling completions post-rollback — quality looks consistent with baseline. Automated eval passrate returning to normal within the 2-minute sample.

Jamal: Triage: sending customer examples + mitigation note to affected customers. Support will use the templated note (draft below).

Marie: Draft customer note (for support to send):

"Hello — we identified an issue affecting some completions from model 'redwood-delta-13b' caused by a recent model promotion. We reverted the rollout and pinned traffic to the previously stable artifact. You should see normal behavior now. If you continue to see issues, please reply with the request id and a short example and we will investigate immediately. Apologies for the disruption. — Redwood Support"

Kai: Good. I'll publish to status page now. Draft status update: 

- Status: Identified & Mitigated
- Impact: Some customers experienced degraded completion quality for ~15min after a model promotion.
- Current status: Rollback completed; traffic pinned to prior stable model; monitoring indicates resolution.
- Next steps: Post-mortem and model onboarding audit. ETA for next update: 2 hours.

Priya: Also adding internal quick-action checklist for the postmortem:
- Capture deploy artifact and training/finetune metadata
- Re-run failing eval suite against both variants
- Check tokenization and safety clamp differences
- Validate CI gating rules and canary thresholds
- Decide whether to block automatic promotion until extra checks added

Elena: Suggest we add a temporary policy: require manual QA sign-off for any delta changes to safety-sensitive models for next two weeks.

Kai: Agreed, put a short freeze and I'll own the policy change.

SRE-Relief: Taking over on-call from Kai in 30m. Kai, please paste a 1-paragraph handoff with outstanding items.

Kai: Handoff -> 1) Incident resolved (rollback to redwood-delta-13b@2026-03-12-4). Monitoring is green. 2) Support to notify 6 affected customers (Marie/Jamal owning). 3) Postmortem assigned to Priya + Elena. 4) Policy change: manual QA for safety-sensitive promotions (Kai owning initial PR). 5) Watchlist: automated eval suite re-run and follow-up telemetry for 24h.

SRE-Relief: Acknowledged, I'll monitor and escalate if we see regression.

Priya: Opening postmortem ticket: INT-2026-0315-01 and linking logs + artifacts. ETA for draft: tomorrow EOD.

Elena: For internal comms — here's a short internal message SRE/Product can use to summarize to executives: 

"Summary: On 2026-03-15, an automated model promotion caused a degradation in completion quality for the redwood-delta-13b model affecting a subset of customers. We reverted the rollout within ~15 minutes, pinned traffic to the last known-good artifact, and have monitoring showing recovery. Root cause investigation and policy changes are in flight; a postmortem will be published within 48 hours"

Kai: Adding quick templates to thread for future incidents — status page & customer notification are above. Internal comms template also above. Keep this thread as the canonical incident record.

Marie: Support will send the customer note to the six customers now and will post updates back into this thread with any replies.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: rollback-1774329165 completed; live traffic at redwood-delta-13b@2026-03-12-4.

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated.

Jamal: Closing loop: will attach customer feedback and any sample completions to the postmortem ticket.

Kai: Thanks all — handing off to SRE-Relief. If anything new appears, mention @Kai. :thumbsup:

SRE-Relief: Logged. Monitoring for 24h and will escalate to Priya/Kai if quality metrics deviate.
